catalogue_card.question: Did ChatGPT Space Pages recover—or not?
catalogue_card.text: OpenAI said Space Pages had recovered at 10:34 UTC on 30 September, then posted a later mitigation update at 15:00. Its status still showed degraded monitoring at the 1 October check. That is a product-service issue, not proof the model got worse.

summary: No reviewed public evidence establishes a broad decline in deployed popular models’ core capability.

OpenAI’s ChatGPT Space Pages incident remained Monitoring / Degraded performance on 1 October, after a 30 September 10:34 recovery update and a later 15:00 mitigation update. The provider does not say whether errors continued or returned.
Anthropic’s status page reported no incidents for 1 October; this is a provider-level snapshot, not proof every account is unaffected.

LiveNerf reported seven of 30 daily Opus 5.5 collections through 30 September. Its launch baseline was still collecting and no post-baseline comparison result was posted; the first possible call was around 24 October.

BridgeBench’s latest displayed Nerf Bench check was 27 September: Opus 5.5 at 99.2% and GPT-6 Astra at 102.8% of launch baselines, within its stated ±10% band. Its tasks and score weights are private, so it is not directly comparable to LiveNerf.
Check the provider status and affected surface before retrying. After recovery, replay the same task and compare only valid completed outputs against a saved baseline.
uncertainty: The OpenAI incident page does not distinguish persistent impact from a recurrence after the earlier recovery statement.
Provider status is aggregate and does not prove what each account can access or how completed answers perform.
LiveNerf has no post-baseline comparison posted; its planned series is narrow to Opus 5.5 on a Claude Code subscription path.
The BridgeBench board is a publisher-described two-model snapshot with no visible sample sizes or task set; its result is four days old at this check.
No representative user denominator, broad repeated consumer-task time series, first-party pool analytics, or controlled audience pilot is available.
freshness_note: Checked 1 October 2026 at 12:24 UTC. OpenAI’s Space Pages page remained degraded/monitoring after a later mitigation update, while Anthropic reported no incident. Public capability evidence remains too early or too narrow to establish broad decline.
